description: Angular component for managing a mobile layout configuration, including drag-and-drop, page management, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: MobileLayoutComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for mobile layout configuration.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (empty implementation).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value based on the provided layout configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form; returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: hideAll
methods.description: Hides all pages.

methods.name: resetToDefault
methods.description: Resets the layout to default configuration.

methods.name: visibleMobilePagesControls
methods.description: Returns controls for visible mobile pages.

methods.name: mobileItemDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of pages.

methods.name: trackByMenuItem
methods.description: Track function for ngFor optimization.

methods.name: addCustomMobilePage
methods.description: Adds a custom mobile page, optionally at a specific index.

methods.name: isCustom
methods.description: Checks if a page is custom.

methods.name: removeCustomPage
methods.description: Removes a custom page at a specified index.

methods.name: showMenuDivider
methods.description: Determines if a menu divider should be shown at an index.

methods.name: getDividerLabel
methods.description: Gets label for a menu divider.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form data.

methods.name: prepareMobilePages
methods.description: Prepares mobile pages array from layout.

methods.name: prepareMobilePagesFormArray
methods.description: Creates a FormArray from MobilePage items.

methods.name: computeMaxIconNameBlockWidth
methods.description: Computes maximum width for icon name block based on breakpoints.

methods.name: pagesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the FormArray of pages.

methods.name: actualMobilePageIndex
methods.description: Gets the index of a page in the form array based on visible controls.
